name: rules-rtdb-r21-validate-on-delete
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r21-validate-on-delete" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). a delete that production allows must not be denied by a `.validate` rule the simulator runs on a null value, and a partial delete production denies must stay denied.
